business_problem: Databricks needed a model that could supervise enterprise agent workflows involving scanned PDFs, legacy files, and long-context documents without the parsing and retrieval errors that frequently break production systems.
solution_summary: Databricks validated GPT-5.5 on OfficeQA Pro, its benchmark for complex enterprise document tasks, and then exposed the model for production use inside customer agent workflows. The benchmark stresses parsing, retrieval, and grounded reasoning across scanned PDFs, legacy files, and long-context enterprise documents, where a single extraction error can derail downstream execution. After GPT-5.5 reduced errors by 46% versus GPT-5.4 and became the first model to exceed 50% accuracy on OfficeQA Pro, Databricks made it available through AI Unity Gateway for workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API. In that architecture, GPT-5.5 supervises specialized agents handling parsing, retrieval, and execution so customers can run more reliable multistep document workflows with fewer search detours and less manual intervention.
